title: Verifier lifecycle array-splats MigrationVersion into positional Modules
rootCause: Invoke-Lifecycle builds a string array containing -MigrationVersion and splats it into a PowerShell script call. Array splatting binds positionally, so the token reaches the Modules parameter instead of named MigrationVersion.
repair: Non-Fresh planning now splats a named MigrationVersion hashtable while Fresh uses an empty hashtable; process execution already uses explicit named CLI arguments. Regression forbids the positional selectionArgs array.
verification: Verifier lifecycle contract passes 6/6 and actual common-edge V135 Fresh, pre-current preparation, Upgrade, RollbackReapply and cleanup all pass.
